summary: PDS Biotechnology Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose receipt of a Nasdaq compliance notice. The company had previously received a deficiency letter on February 25, 2026, because its stock traded below $1.00 for 30 consecutive days. On June 2, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that PDSB had regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement and closed the matter. This filing is a routine regulatory update regarding listing standards and does not constitute a special situation event. There are no deal terms, structural changes, or strategic actions involved.
